_help: MSI Thin GF63 12VE (EC 16R8IMS1.117). Recipes per GhostDeck models.json entry 'MSI Thin GF63 12VE' (verified): performance = Extreme (0xD2=C4, 0xEB=00), balanced = Balanced (0xD2=C1, 0xEB=00), eco = Super Battery / MSI 'ECO-Silent' (0xD2=C2, 0xEB=0F). Fan mode is always 0x8D (curve). speeds[0] = below upTemps[0]; speeds[i] = from upTemps[i-1]; speeds[6] = above upTemps[5]; fan steps down downOffsets[i] C below each threshold. Speed % 0-150 (120+ = max 6666 rpm). NEVER exactly 100 (fan stops). Switch: msi-fan.ps1 mode <name>.
